consent.title: Help us improve the test?
consent.body: With your permission, the app sends anonymous usage statistics to Google Analytics, such as when a test is started or finished and the overall score. Your answers stay on this phone. Nothing is used for advertising or to track you across apps, and you can change your mind any time in Settings.
